lines: When they keep canceling, they just want a backup.
You get ready, wait, and end up alone.
Their “maybe later” turns into a regular excuse.
Doubt starts creeping into how you see yourself.
The truth: they’re scared of commitment, not of you.
Spot the pattern and stop playing second choice.
Pick friends who treat your time like yours.
Your schedule deserves real plans, not empty promises, you deserve that.
Follow for more daily life changing videos.

caption: Don’t be a second choice. Share this with anyone who needs to see their worth.
